# Alliance Mutual Escrow

> Independent escrow company licensed by the California Department of Financial
> Protection and Innovation (DFPI). Serving all of California from Tustin.
> Phone (714) 544-6525. Email info@ameescrow.com.

Alliance Mutual Escrow is a neutral third party in real estate transactions:
it holds funds and documents under signed instructions, verifies earnest money,
orders title searches, coordinates signing, confirms lender funding, and records
deeds. It is not a brokerage and not a bank. Escrow stays neutral; the real
estate agent hands over the keys.

Published fees: sale escrow $300 base plus $2.15 per $1,000 of sale price, each
side. SFR refinance flat tiers: $650 to $750k, $850 to $1M, $1,200 to $2M,
quoted above $2M, processing $200. Multi-family/commercial refinance $95 base
plus $0.95 per $1,000, $500,000 loan minimum.
